title: Search the branch’s code from a review
intent: Let the reviewer search the whole branch for a name from a question or note (e.g. toggleSharePointInterface) and see where it is used, without leaving Reviewer

chapters.title: Search the branch’s code
chapters.why: A question like 'what does toggleSharePointInterface do with…' needs the code around the change, not only the diff. projects.searchCode (already in 4f0d4b5) runs git grep over the whole branch: the checkout with uncommitted and untracked files when there is one, else the branch's commit; plain text, smart case, 20 matches a file, 300 in all, .review excluded. The panel (/ or Cmd+F, or the header button) fills in the selected text, groups matches by file with the change's files first, marks lines this change added with their step, and shows nine lines around a match from fileLines.
chapters.risk: The query goes to git as one -e argument with --fixed-strings and execFile, so it is never a pattern or shell text.
checks: Cmd+F no longer does nothing in a review: it opens this search.
The query stays while the panel is closed on the same screen; going from the plan to a step starts empty.
